resolution.note: agentWith waits until the job shell child is the named program (sleep/node), so the fork-before-exec bash child no longer reads as work; 23/23 three runs

title: hc busy test races the waiter fork before exec sleep
body:
CI on main ea5c0da (run 44062857802, Test 10/13) failed test/claude/terminal-host-hc.test.ts:363 `busy is false for ... a waiting job`: expected false, actual true. The setup loop in agentWith waits until the job shell has any child; right after fork, before exec, that child is still `bash`, so hasChildShell (src/successor/command.ts waiting()) sees a non-sleep child and reports busy. Passes 6/6 locally at low load.
Outcome: the test waits until the job shell's child is the expected program (sleep for the waiter, node for the working job) before probing busy.
Proof: node --test test/claude/terminal-host-hc.test.ts exits 0 and the setup waits on the child command name
